resources.string: Answer a question to keep using the phone.
Advanced lock: keeps the quiz on screen when time is up.

KidGuard uses this to see which app is on screen while a session is running. When time is up or the phone is locked, it closes the notification shade and brings the quiz back instead of other apps, recents or the home screen. During a session it also stops KidGuard\'s own settings and uninstall pages from opening. KidGuard does not read, store or send what is on your screen.
